text: The Agda library 'HoTT-Agda' (Brunerie et al.) versus the 'Cubical' library differ mainly in that:
choices: HoTT-Agda uses axioms (univalence is an axiom); Cubical uses definitional univalence
HoTT-Agda is for topology; Cubical is for algebra
explanation: HoTT-Agda postulates univalence and funext (no computation rules). The cubical library (--cubical) has computational univalence (via Glue). The cubical approach is more robust but requires Cubical Agda.
